extDescription.message: Speeds up working with logs in Kibana Discover: action buttons built from log fields.

errorForbidden.message: kibanatool: you are not allowed to read this log

errorIncompatible.message: kibanatool: possibly incompatible with this Kibana version ($VERSION$)

optionsIntro.message: Add the Kibana addresses you use, grant access, then define link actions. Reload open Kibana tabs after changes.

optionsLoadError.message: The stored settings are invalid, so empty settings are in use. Saving anything replaces the stored settings:

optionsSavedReload.message: Saved. Reload open Kibana tabs to apply.

optionsActionsHelp.message: A JSON array of actions. Placeholders use {field} or {field|fallback}. Example: [{"id":"admin","kind":"link","label":"Admin","enabled":true,"environmentIds":[],"conditions":[],"urlTemplate":"https://admin.example.com/users/{user_id}"}]

discoverNoTime.message: No time to center on: the data view has no time field or this log has no value for it

noticeTimeNotConverted.message: Could not convert the time range to fixed dates

optionsPermissionError.message: Chrome could not update the access permission: $ERROR$

optionsMarkdownFields.message: Fields for "Copy as Markdown", one per line (empty: every field, alphabetically)

optionsMaskPatterns.message: Masked fields, one pattern per line (* matches anything; case does not matter)

optionsImportPreview.message: This file has $ENVIRONMENTS$ environments and $ACTIONS$ actions. Importing replaces all current settings; grant access to the environments afterwards.
